.section .text
.global nn_shl_c

nn_shl_c:
    // x0 = dest pointer, x1 = src pointer, x2 = count, x3 = shift amount, x4 = carry-in
    // Save dest pointer and initialize carry
    mov     x9, x0
    mov     x0, x4
    
    // Early exit if count <= 0
    cmp     x2, #0
    b.le    L_exit
    
    // Handle shift == 0 case efficiently
    cbz     x3, L_copy_loop
    
    // Precompute shift values
    mov     w10, #64
    sub     w10, w10, w3         // 64 - shift
    sub     w8, w3, #64          // shift - 64
    
    // Check if shift >= 64
    cmp     w8, #0
    b.ge    L_large_shift
    
    // Main loop for normal shifts (0 < shift < 64)
    // 4x unrolled for better performance with better instruction scheduling
    lsr     x11, x2, #2          // count/4 iterations
    cbz     x11, L_normal_remainder
    
L_normal_loop:
    // First element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    lsl     x7, x5, x3
    add     x0, x0, x7
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsr     x0, x5, x10
    
    // Second element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    lsl     x7, x5, x3
    add     x0, x0, x7
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsr     x0, x5, x10
    
    // Third element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    lsl     x7, x5, x3
    add     x0, x0, x7
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsr     x0, x5, x10
    
    // Fourth element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    lsl     x7, x5, x3
    add     x0, x0, x7
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsr     x0, x5, x10
    
    subs    x11, x11, #1
    b.ne    L_normal_loop
    
L_normal_remainder:
    // Handle remaining elements (0-3)
    ands    x2, x2, #3
    b.eq    L_normal_done
    
L_normal_remainder_loop:
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    lsl     x7, x5, x3
    add     x0, x0, x7
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsr     x0, x5, x10
    subs    x2, x2, #1
    b.ne    L_normal_remainder_loop
    
L_normal_done:
    ret

L_large_shift:
    // shift >= 64: all bits shift out, carry propagates
    // x8 = shift - 64
    // 4x unrolled for better performance
    lsr     x11, x2, #2          // count/4 iterations
    cbz     x11, L_large_remainder
    
L_large_loop:
    // First element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsl     x0, x5, x8
    
    // Second element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsl     x0, x5, x8
    
    // Third element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsl     x0, x5, x8
    
    // Fourth element
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsl     x0, x5, x8
    
    subs    x11, x11, #1
    b.ne    L_large_loop
    
L_large_remainder:
    // Handle remaining elements (0-3)
    ands    x2, x2, #3
    b.eq    L_large_done
    
L_large_remainder_loop:
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    lsl     x0, x5, x8
    subs    x2, x2, #1
    b.ne    L_large_remainder_loop
    
L_large_done:
    ret

L_copy_loop:
    // shift == 0: just copy with carry addition
    // Process first element with carry, then use load-pair/store-pair for efficiency
    cmp     x2, #0
    b.le    L_exit
    
    // First element with carry
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    add     x0, x0, x5
    str     x0, [x9], #8
    subs    x2, x2, #1
    b.le    L_exit_zero_carry
    
    // Now carry is zero, process remaining in pairs
    lsr     x11, x2, #1          // count/2 iterations
    cbz     x11, L_copy_single
    
L_copy_rest_loop:
    ldp     x5, x6, [x1], #16
    stp     x5, x6, [x9], #16
    subs    x11, x11, #1
    b.ne    L_copy_rest_loop
    
    // Handle odd remaining element
    tbz     x2, #0, L_exit_zero_carry
    
L_copy_single:
    ldr     x5, [x1], #8
    str     x5, [x9], #8
    
L_exit_zero_carry:
    mov     x0, xzr
    ret

L_exit:
    ret
